why: The fast-food restaurant in Rancho Coronado where Kerry takes V for coffee at the end of 'Rebel! Rebel!'. Its building, furniture, doors and loot are ordinary world streaming; its normal cook, waitress and seven patrons are the whole open-world community #sq017_fast_food_com, which the kept district phase std_rcr already switches on ungated. This proposal re-issues that community as the playbook's boot + proximity safety net, and leaves the sq017 coffee-scene prefab, its duplicate 'Caliente folks' staff and Kerry's quest spawn sets out.

open_questions: Does the kept district phase std_rcr actually populate the restaurant in a fresh clean-slate start? The static evidence says yes (ungated whole-community Activate on a node directly on the phase input, and std_rcr is a kept child of open_world_global_commuinity_phase), but this needs one in-game look; the re-issued community in this proposal is the fallback and the rule-6 safety net either way.

Are the three world doors powered and unlocked by default? No sq017 phase issues a DoorControllerPS action, so they keep their world defaults and are outside the runtime door policy's quest-driven scope. The tour must confirm a customer can walk in through the north wall.

Which of the two single_door instances is the everyday customer entrance (331.59,-1622.60 vs 324.18,-1621.98)? Both are ordinary doors on the same wall; the proposal anchors on the eastern one near the waitress spots. The anchor choice is a streaming convenience, not a claim about the front door.

Are the always-streamed quest props (coffee cups, sit interaction, look-at markers) enabled and visible in normal play, and does #sq017_sit_interaction_caliente offer a prompt at an empty table? If it does, it is harmless but worth noting for the scene-free look.

The catalogue reports the whole community's posture as relaxed, aggregated from workspots; the nine individual entries were not all spot-checked. Confirm on the tour that nobody is frozen in a scene pose or sitting inside furniture.

communities.why: The restaurant's ordinary open-world set: cook Character.sq017_caliente_staff at the wok/wash-hands spots, waitress Character.Waitress on standing/tablet spots, and seven patrons (CorpoManAfterWork, CorpoWomanAfterWork, LowlifeMale/Woman, CitizenAldecaldosMale/FemaleTeenager, and the second CorpoManAfterWork entry sq017_kerry_table) on stand, sit-chair-table and sit-barstool workspots. Vanilla activates this whole community with entry None/phase None on an ungated leaf of the kept district phase std_rcr, so the clean slate should already populate the venue; the re-issue is the rule-6 second activation after proximity, because a one-shot boot activation can miss a streamable community that has not streamed in yet.

deferred_prefab_owner: world streaming (the chosen people need no quest prefab)

proximity_wait.why: The restaurant's north-wall street door, a plain single_door.ent (DoorControllerPS, appearance doors_single_entropy_j) in the venue's device prefab. The cooked sector exterior_5_-26_0_0 places this entity at (331.59, -1622.60, 9.37); its world node id 18351170305799752074 equals FNV-1a-64 of the ref path with '#' removed, which confirms the path. It streams with the venue, sits at the wall beside the crowd (nearest waitress spot is (332.18,-1627.64,9.30), about 5 m south), and a player standing there is inside the venue's streaming radius.
